notes.title: ECLIPSIUM IS OUT NOW ON STEAM
notes.notes:
[p]Ayo!
[/p][p]You read the title of this post, so we’ll keep this short and sweet. [/p][p][/p][p]Eclipsium is OUT NOW on Steam, so come feast your eyes, ears, and hand(s) on our equally heartbreaking and disturbing little story!  [/p][previewyoutube="03kHdsynrdA;full"][/previewyoutube][h3]Here’s what awaits you in Eclipsium:[/h3][list][*][p][i]A layered story through a nightmare-fueled world, that we’ve infused with as much emotional weight as we possibly can.[/i][/p][/*][*][p][i]Fantastical body horror that will hopefully make you squint your eyes a little. And maybe say “Ew!”. But, it’s tasteful also.[/i][/p][/*][*][p][i]Unique handcrafted locations: church like slaughterhouses, cursed forests, at some point you’re falling in a neverending, repeating space![/i][/p][/*][*][p][i]Visuals have gotten a glowup: we have honed and refined the art style that defines Eclipsium, while minimizing pesky head aches.[/i][/p][/*][*][p][i]Over 20 tracks of custom-written, intense songs to go with the dreamlike visuals. Each one a banger.[/i][/p][/*][/list][p]Eclipsium is also 10% off during the launch week as a part of CRITICAL REFLEX Publisher Sale, so make sure to grab it (pun not intended) while it lasts!
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44091159/496f1813c027f984fc0530d628d571318f6cfe01.gif"][/img][/p][p]The journey to release was both exciting and terrifying, and getting there is even more so. Eclipsium came a long way since its inception as a little GMTK Game Jam title, and we are beyond grateful for all the support from everyone’s been around since way back then![/p][p][/p][p]Please, enjoy Eclipsium, contemplate over it, have fun, get emotional — we hope you like it. And see you on the other side.[/p][p][/p][p][i]Staying with you in sickness and health,[/i][/p][p][i]Housefire Games & CR Channel Crew[/i][/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44091159/dabb45003daee8a7655145e0748314940082c45f.png"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44091159/71533114fa83e7ef73a6e15765050fba452a8a16.png"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44091159/5df629c5a25c2a28fadc4161445cb7e8986fd2d3.png"][/img][/p]

notes.title: Thank You and What’s Next
notes.notes:
[p]Ayo![/p][p][/p][p]We’re stunned and deeply touched to announce that Eclipsium has entered the Top 500 most wishlisted games on Steam! As developers, releasing anything is a constant roller coaster of excitement and despair, but your tremendous support and the Eclipsium Demo’s positive reception is frankly overwhelming. Thank you for taking the time to play it and for giving us your invaluable feedback! Now, that energy is fueling us to deliver a game that will literally melt your minds. [/p][p][/p][p]While we’re at it, we’d like to address some of the feedback we’ve received during the demo and trailer reveal. We had a few reports about the visual style being too eye-straining and some people experiencing motion sickness, so we went over the palette and adjusted contrast levels, softening the granulating and smoothing lightning, adjusted the tractor beams, made some sacrifices to the appropriate lesser demons and out came a reimagined shader that keeps the haunting atmosphere that defines Eclipsium. Let us know what y’all think about the changes plz![/p][p][/p][previewyoutube="GS_JCuzObIQ;full"][/previewyoutube][p][/p][p]We keep pouring our hearts and souls into Eclipsium, and are doing our best to give you all an experience that lingers long after the screen fades to black. So thank you once again, and see you soon.[/p][p][/p][p]The light fades. The release draws near.[/p][p][/p][p]Housefire Games & CR Channel[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44091159/dabb45003daee8a7655145e0748314940082c45f.png"][/img]

[dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/2419670/Eclipsium/"][/dynamiclink][/p]

notes.title: Eclipsium has been nominated for PC Gamer's "Most Wanted" Game Show!
notes.notes:
[h2]Nomination[/h2]
Eclipsium has been nominated alongside 99 other games for PCGamers "Most Wanted" Game Show!

notes.title: New Demo page - Live Now!
notes.notes:
[h3]Ayo![/h3]

Steam recently updated how [b]demos[/b] can be displayed, giving more power and options to us, the developers. We won't cover all the details, but the important part is that there's now a [b][u]new page for the Eclipsium demo![/u][/b]

[h3]What will change?[/h3]
[list]
[*] You can now [b][u]leave a review[/u][/b] on the demo!
[*] It's easier to manage the demo in your Steam library
[*]The demo page can appear in more places on Steam
[/list]
[h3]Why are you telling me this?[/h3]
Mostly because we would greatly appreciate each and every one of you [b][u]leaving a review[/u][/b] on the demo. We read and value all the feedback we receive, so the more the merrier. It also helps us grow and reach more people through Steam. 

[h3]Is the demo updated?[/h3]
Right now our number one priority is to work on the final version of the game rather than updating the demo. This means that all the content in the demo is the same as before (other than minor bug fixes).

If you still have any questions, don't hesitate to ask us.

[u]So what are you waiting for? Go play the demo if you haven't already, and please [b]leave us a review![/b][/u]

///[i]Housefire[/i]

notes.title: Exciting News!
notes.notes:
[h3]Ayo![/h3]

Only been a couple of weeks this time since we last spoke even though it feels like yesterday. Time flies! 

[h3]Let's start of with : Wishlists![/h3]
Eclipsium recently surpassed over [u][b]11.000 wishlists[/b][/u]! To say we never imagined we'd get this far would be an understatement. We want to thank each and everyone of you who've shown support to this passion project, truly. With this comes a feeling of great responsibility, we're working harder than ever to make sure the game lives up to your expectations. 

[h3]Can't forget : Events![/h3]
You might have noticed Eclipsium popping up in a few different places on the web. That's because we had the pleasure of being part of: 

[url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=2GzhFo6iRmw][b]Games to Get Excited About Fest 2024[/b][/url] hosted by [url=https://www.youtube.com/@alphabetagamer][u]Alpha Beta Gamer[/u][/url]  

[url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=8tG-jv3BGYA][b]Indie FPS summer showcase[/b][/url] hosted by [url=https://www.youtube.com/c/Zlimbratski][u]ZlimBratSki[/u][/url]. 

These were both amazing events that showcased the mind-blowing creativity and passion of the current indie game landscape. We're super proud to be shown next to these amazing games and a huge thank you to [url=https://www.youtube.com/@alphabetagamer][u]Alpha Beta Gamer[/u][/url] and [url=https://www.youtube.com/c/Zlimbratski][u]ZlimBratSki[/u][/url]! Make sure to check out their channels and content.  

[h3]Last but not least : Playtesting![/h3]
As we're expanding the game and adding new content, we'll run regular playtests to make sure everything's up to par in terms of clarity and quality. While we can't share the details quite yet on [i]when[/i] we will start hosting playtests, we can with certainty say [i]where[/i]. our [url=https://discord.gg/7Gkq2dMZGb][u]Discord[/u][/url] server! 

If [b]YOU[/b] want to be part of improving Eclipsium by playtesting it and giving us valuable feedback, make sure to join our [url=https://discord.gg/7Gkq2dMZGb][u]Discord[/u][/url] server to stay up to date once we announce the start of playtesting! 

As always, Discord and Twitter are the best places to follow along the development. Until next time! 

[h3]Discord : [url=https://discord.gg/7Gkq2dMZGb]Link[/url][/h3]
[h3]Twitter / X : [url=https://x.com/Housefiregames]Link[/url][/h3]

notes.title: Eclipsium - Quick Devpost!
notes.notes:
[h3]Ayo![/h3]
Last time we shared a devpost was a couple of months ago and a lot has happended since then so we thought we'd give you all a quick update.

[h3]- Development[/h3]
We've been hard at work planning, refining and creating content for the game. We're super excited about what we have in the works and we can't wait for you all to experience it.  Here's a quick sneak peak of one of the new areas we've added to the game. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44091159/7a8d74fd590dbf19f9f837d2dba8367260bd42ed.gif[/img]
[h3]- Graduation[/h3]
Last week Eclipsium graduated! Well, all developers working on the game did. Eclipsium originally started off as a student project which we then decided to keep working on during our studies. Having now graduated, we're happy to say that the entire team is committed to continue development full-time! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44091159/04cc8df7166338651032c560ed6d95e6104ada5a.png[/img]
[h3]- Thank you[/h3]
Lastly we want to give a huuuuuge thank you to everyone who has supported the game up to this point and beyond. We wouldn't be here doing this if it wasn't for you and we couldn't be happier ːluvː

For more sneak peaks into the development of Eclipsium go follow us on Twitter and join our discord server!
